headline: Kalyani Investment Company Limited appoints a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
summary: Kalyani Investment Company Limited has officially notified the stock exchange regarding the appointment of a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. This is a routine corporate governance filing required under regulatory norms. Such administrative updates have no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation. Retail investors tracking the stock need not factor this regulatory filing into their investment decisions.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no bearing on share price.

headline: Kalyani Investment Company reports Q2 FY27 financial results
hook: Standalone and consolidated September quarter results filed
summary: Kalyani Investment Company Limited has submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These regulatory filings provide investors with a formal update on the company's financial performance and profitability during the period. Retail shareholders can review these official statements on the exchange portals to assess the company's operational standing.
whats_next: Review of the reported quarterly financials by market participants
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for shareholder review.
